svg.title: Before and after: 101 backup pairs and 78% disk use become 10 pairs and a projected 65%
svg.text: QuantVPS web build backups: keep the newest 10
Measured on QuantVPS 2026-11-15 19:43 UTC. Each square = one backup pair (88 to 181 MiB).
101 pairs, 11.3 GiB, no rule deletes them
newest 10 pairs stay (1.2 GiB), 91 older pairs are deleted, 10.1 GiB free
at most 3 pairs deleted (about 0.4 GiB), oldest first
Disk 77.35 GiB total. The "after" values are computed from the measured size of each pair.
